visualRisks.description: The path from row 15 to 100 is obstructed by water. The player might get stuck or confused.
visualRisks.suggestion: Consider adding a bridge or another means of crossing the water.

visualRisks.description: Road width varies, which could be confusing for players navigating the district.
visualRisks.suggestion: Ensure consistent road widths to improve navigation.

navigationRisks.description: The route seems to loop back on itself after row 123, which could lead to player frustration or disorientation.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Review the route and ensure it leads to a clear destination.

navigationRisks.description: Some rows in the district do not have any landmarks or destinations, making navigation less engaging.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Add more landmarks or destinations throughout the district.
